About the Practice

Albany Medical Center is the anchor of the Albany Med Health System and the only academic medical center serving northeastern New York and western New England. It is a not-for-profit health system providing the highest level of patient care across a wide range of medical and surgical specialties, alongside a commitment to medical education and biomedical research. The center includes a 766-bed hospital, a Level I Adult and Pediatric Trauma Center, and the Bernard & Millie Duker Children's Hospital. [3, 4, 6, 11]

Electronic Health Record System

Epic

Primary Electronic Health Record System

Research Analysis
Methodology & Findings

Albany Medical Center, part of the Albany Med Health System, uses the MyChart patient portal. This transition to MyChart is linked to the Albany Med Health System's implementation of Epic as their single, unified electronic medical record (EMR) system. The MyChart portal allows patients to manage appointments, request prescription refills, view test results, message their doctors, and access their health records online. This new system replaced previous patient portals used across the health system locations.
